report_issue_clusters.observed: The following transitions realise the condition the requirement states as a guard by writing it as the transition label, i.e. as the trigger event: (1) DoorsClosing -> InMotion: label `Closed/SendDeparted`, required guard 'doors are closed' (PlantUML line 4: `DoorsClosing --> InMotion: Closed/SendDeparted`) (2) Accelerating -> Cruising: label `Reached Cruising/Cruise`, required guard 'cruising speed is reached' (PlantUML line 8: `Accelerating --> Cruising : Reached Cruising/Cruise`) (3) Accelerating -> Approaching: label `Approached/Decelerate`, required guard 'approaches its destination' (PlantUML line 9: `Accelerating --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`) (4) Cruising -> Approaching: label `Approached/Decelerate`, required guard 'approaches the destination' (PlantUML line 10: `Cruising --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`) In PlantUML a label without brackets is the trigger; the closed model therefore declares one opaque event named after each condition and none of these transitions has a guard. Author source: PlantUML line 2: state `DoorsClosing` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 6: state `InMotion` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 4: `DoorsClosing --> InMotion: Closed/SendDeparted`; PlantUML line 12: state `Accelerating` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 13: state `Cruising` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 8: `Accelerating --> Cruising : Reached Cruising/Cruise`; PlantUML line 14: state `Approaching` (explicit declaration); PlantUML line 9: `Accelerating --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`; PlantUML line 10: `Cruising --> Approaching : Approached/Decelerate`.
